verdict.rationale: Buzz documents voice huddles: agents can 'drop into voice huddles' and the relay hosts huddle audio. Nothing in the evidence shows AI-generated notes, transcripts or recaps of huddles or meetings, whether the user attended or missed them. Agents searching message history is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated notes and recaps from meetings and huddles I attended or missed
